movie.title: The Abyss
movie.overview: Dasha and Sasha are a happy newlywed. A honeymoon and a parachute jump over the foothills of Mount Elbrus are supposed to be the beginning of their new life. But fate intervenes. The pilot turns out to be Artyom - Dasha's ex, a man she didn't even want to remember. When the plane crashes, the three are forced to jump without training. The lines get tangled. They miraculously survive - but find themselves suspended over a mountain abyss amid raging forest fires. Dasha finds herself between two men, each of whom is tied to her life. One is the present. The other is an unhealed past.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: A honeymoon trip turns into a fight for survival when a newlywed couple and the bride's ex-boyfriend end up stranded together above a mountain abyss after a plane crash.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Newlyweds Dasha and Sasha head to Mount Elbrus for a romantic honeymoon involving a parachute jump. Tensions rise when they discover their pilot is Artyom, Dasha's troubled ex-boyfriend. After a disastrous plane crash forces them into an emergency jump, they survive only to find themselves suspended over a sheer mountain drop amidst spreading forest fires. Entangled in both parachutes and unresolved emotional history, Dasha must navigate survival alongside the man of her present and the ghost of her past.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Dasha and Sasha are a deeply in love newlywed couple embarking on what should be the trip of a lifetime. To celebrate their marriage, they plan an exhilarating parachute jump over the scenic foothills of Mount Elbrus. However, their dream honeymoon takes a dark turn before they even take off when they discover the aircraft's pilot is Artyom, Dasha's ex-lover whom she had desperately tried to forget. As old feelings and unspoken resentments surface in the cabin, a sudden mechanical disaster strikes, sending the plane spiraling downward. With no time to spare, the untrained group is forced to make a dangerous emergency jump into the unknown. Miraculously surviving the drop, their relief is short-lived as their parachutes entangle, leaving them dangling precariously over a massive mountain abyss. To make matters worse, raging forest fires begin to sweep through the surrounding wilderness, closing in on their fragile lifeline. Trapped high above the ground, Dasha finds herself physically and emotionally suspended between the husband representing her future and the ex representing an unhealed past. Together, the trio must overcome treacherous elements and personal conflicts if any of them hope to make it out alive.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: The Abyss is an edge-of-your-seat survival thriller that fuses heart-pounding physical danger with intense emotional drama. Following newlyweds Dasha and Sasha on a romantic honeymoon flight over Mount Elbrus, their world is upended when Dasha's ex-boyfriend Artyom appears as their pilot. When a mid-air crisis forces an emergency parachute escape, the trio lands trapped together high above a mountain chasm with forest fires raging around them. Blending high-stakes tension with a deeply personal love triangle, the narrative explores endurance, forgiveness, and the choices that define our lives under extreme pressure.

story_structure.climax: Suspended over the deadly drop, the physical danger peaks alongside the emotional stakes as Dasha is caught in a literal and psychological crucible between the two men—her current husband representing her present, and her ex representing an unresolved past.
story_structure.conflict: The couple discovers their pilot is Artyom, Dasha's estranged ex-boyfriend whom she desperately wants to forget, creating intense emotional tension right before the plane suddenly crashes.
story_structure.resolution: The narrative outlines the ultimate test of survival and emotional closure, forcing Dasha to confront her past traumas and make a definitive choice regarding who and what truly anchors her life moving forward.
story_structure.introduction: Dasha and Sasha are happily married newlyweds who embark on a honeymoon trip featuring a scenic parachute jump over the picturesque foothills of Mount Elbrus.
story_structure.risingAction: Forced to bail out of the failing aircraft without training, the trio's parachute lines become dangerously tangled, leaving them miraculously alive but trapped, suspended directly over a terrifying mountain abyss surrounded by advancing forest fires.
